services.name: Haunted Harbour Ghost Tours
services.desc: Lake Winnipeg, a prairie ocean hidden in the heartland, holds untold stories of triumph and tragedy. Here at the Marine Museum of Manitoba, the spirits of the past are eager to be heard, waiting for you to uncover their tales. From the late 1800s to the 1960s, this land, the water, and the ships themselves were witness to a vibrant seafaring era. At the Marine Museum, the spirits of the past still walk the halls and stand upon the bows of these now landlocked ships. For countless years, both staff and visitors aboard the historic ships at the Marine Museum have encountered inexplicable phenomena. blurb: Established in 1972 the Marine Museum of Manitoba provides visitors with a hands on, heritage experience. We tell the story of the development and the operation of marine life on Lake Winnipeg and the Red River circa 1850 to present day.
